examples.input_condition: A conversion-factor calculation supplies a numeric activity value without its fuel-volume, electricity-kWh or travel-distance unit
examples.expected_action: Reject the calculation until activity_unit is explicit and compatible with the selected factor denominator
examples.risk_prevented: Magnitude errors caused by litres, kWh, miles, kilometres or tonnes being treated as interchangeable

examples.input_condition: A conversion-factor result contains Scope 1, Scope 2 or Scope 3 components
examples.expected_action: Store and total each scope separately; do not collapse the components into an unlabeled emissions value
examples.risk_prevented: Double counting and loss of accounting boundary

examples.input_condition: Physical activity data are unavailable and a spend-based multiplier is used
examples.expected_action: Classify the result as spend_based_initial_assessment and disclose the method; do not promote it as a measured or activity-based value

examples.input_condition: A calculation uses the UK government 2026 conversion-factor set
examples.expected_action: Persist factor_release_year=2026, source version and reporting period; reject silent reuse for another annual release

examples.input_condition: A year-on-year result changes after a new annual factor workbook is released
examples.expected_action: Check the official major-changes and worksheet guidance before classifying the movement as operational
examples.risk_prevented: Treating a factor-method revision as a real emissions change

examples.input_condition: The automatic-processing flat file is ingested without workbook or methodology metadata
examples.expected_action: Require publication date, factor identifier, unit, scope and methodology lineage before accepting calculated outputs
examples.risk_prevented: Machine-readable rows losing their interpretation context

examples.input_condition: A provisional territorial estimate and a later final estimate refer to the same calendar year
examples.expected_action: Keep publication_stage and vintage distinct; supersede only through an explicit revision link
examples.risk_prevented: Mixing early estimates with accredited final-series values

examples.input_condition: Different greenhouse gases are aggregated into CO2e for the current official UK measures
examples.risk_prevented: Combining totals calculated under incompatible GWP frameworks

examples.input_condition: A territorial total includes CO2 from burning wood, straw, biogas or similar biomass
examples.expected_action: Keep biogenic CO2 outside the territorial energy total where the official measure reports it through land-use carbon-stock change

examples.input_condition: International aviation or shipping is presented as part of the territorial total
examples.expected_action: Exclude it from the territorial series unless an explicitly different official measure is being used
examples.risk_prevented: Expanding the territorial boundary beyond the published definition

examples.input_condition: Transport emissions involve UK operators abroad or foreign operators inside the UK
examples.expected_action: For residence accounting include UK residents and UK-registered businesses abroad and exclude foreign operators in the UK
examples.risk_prevented: Confusing physical location with residence-based economic ownership

examples.input_condition: A footprint total contains emissions embedded in imports or UK-produced exports
examples.expected_action: Include supply-chain emissions for UK consumption and exclude emissions associated with exported UK production

examples.input_condition: Footprint, territorial and residence figures are compared using their latest available releases
examples.expected_action: Require a common reference year because footprint estimates are published with a longer lag
examples.risk_prevented: Comparing values from different years as though contemporaneous

examples.input_condition: A UK ETS measurement or calculation has an uncertainty assessment
examples.expected_action: Store measurement_uncertainty separately from source-quality or provenance-confidence scores
examples.risk_prevented: Using a statistical uncertainty percentage as a data-authenticity score

examples.input_condition: Reported emissions pass through multiple meters, spreadsheets or calculation steps
examples.expected_action: Require an auditable data-flow description, risk assessment and control activities before acceptance
examples.risk_prevented: Undetected transcription, formula and handoff errors

examples.input_condition: A calculation factor depends on sampling or laboratory analysis
examples.expected_action: Persist sampling plan, analytical method, sample period and laboratory provenance; do not accept an orphan factor
examples.risk_prevented: Applying untraceable sample results to annual emissions

examples.input_condition: CEMS, automated sampling or periodic monitoring results are available for the same release
examples.expected_action: Apply the permit and official monitoring-method hierarchy; never average fundamentally different methods without reconciliation
examples.risk_prevented: Blending measurements with different temporal coverage and quality controls

examples.input_condition: An ultra-small emitter exceeds 2500 tCO2e in a scheme year
examples.expected_action: Flag threshold_exceeded, retain monitoring-plan methodology and trigger the required regulator-notification workflow rather than leaving the installation in the prior classification
